newsitem.title: USA: Raleigh Capital extends tender for Arvida/JMB.
newsitem.headline: Raleigh Capital extends tender for Arvida/JMB.

text.p: Raleigh Capital Associates LP on Friday said it extended the expiration date of its offer to purchase up to about 22 percent of the outstanding limited partnership interests and assignee interests of Arvida/JMB Partners LP.
The revised deadline for accepting Raleigh's offer to buy units of the limited property development partnership at $500 each is midnight EST (0500 GMT) on Friday, March 21.
Raleigh said about 31,259.78 units had been deposited under its offer as of the close of business on March 6.

Raleigh said its decision to extend the closing of its tender offer was the result of uncertainty arising from efforts by the general partner to deny voting rights to holders who did not acquire their units in the 1987 original public offering.
Raleigh said it thought that all unitholders had voting rights. A hearing on the issue of voting rights is scheduled to be held in the Delaware Chancery Court on April 7, 8 and 9.
